issues.explanation: Chapter 115 introduces 邵悌 as the adviser warning 司马昭, but Chapter 116 suddenly has 邵缓 interpreting 邓艾’s dream without introduction. The near-identical names make it unclear whether this is the same character or an accidental name change.
issues.suggested_fix: Use one consistent name if 邵悌 and 邵缓 are the same person; otherwise briefly identify 邵缓 before giving the interpretation.
